Recheck Claude interest/downrank reason falsely claiming hands-on activities not confirmed. Preserve distinction between spoken explanation and real hands-on opportunities.
Already registered CU Boulder source; verify paginated Localist feed and event extraction completeness before suggesting missed sources.
Organizer lists 2027 museum free days; 2027-11-15 and 2027-12-13 fall within expected Jun 2027–Aug 2028 family visit; no admission booking needed now. Do not confuse 2026 events with 2027 dates.

notes: Independent research and cross-check performed for 2026 Colorado locals vs family Jun 2027–Aug 2028. 120 actual fast-search requests across nine batches; 118 query texts reconstructed, 2 exact raw strings could not be recovered and are not invented. URL read attempts include page opens/clicks and 5 late independent source confirmations; two original failures were an HTTP 429 and an unavailable/disabled link. Not all candidate decisions represent new events; duplicates and ordinary outings were actively excluded. GitHub collector comparison is based on live external-inbox pipeline verdict, not merely absence from source registry. Artnauts and DMNS already found; Emergence previously found but recommendation-excluded despite official explicit hands-on invitation. 3 submitted event records were saved and re-opened; two GitHub workflows both completed successfully and reverified official pages. Aggregate digest one message cannot be attributed to submitted events. Both immediate dispatches reported zero; event-specific confirmed Telegram deliveries 0. GitHub collector code unchanged, no Telegram direct calls. Family of five museum standard pricing $27.95*2+$20.95*3=$118.75. Museum free day requires no general admission ticket; optional theater/planetarium extra. 2027 dates on DMNS official calendar Nov 15 and Dec 13 are within projected family stay, but not submitted a year early because no booking deadline/action.
